root_cause: Arrow key navigation in Pikaday ignores the disableDayFn callback, causing ArrowRight/Left/Up/DOWN to move to dates that are disabled (e.g., weekends).
repair_strategy: Replace the direct adjustDate calls in _onKeyChange with a loop that repeatedly adjusts the date until a non-disabled date is found, respecting opts.disableDayFn and min/max limits via a safety counter.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can reliably navigate only to selectable dates, ensuring arrow keys skip weekends and other disabled days, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard operability and predictable focus order.
functional_risks: Potential infinite loop if all dates are disabled (mitigated by 100‑iteration safety limit).
Performance impact if many consecutive disabled days exist (unlikely in typical use).
If minDate or maxDate is disabled, navigation may stop at the boundary and not move further.
verification_requirements: ArrowRight from a Friday selects the following Monday (skipping Saturday and Sunday).
ArrowLeft from a Monday selects the previous Friday.
Up/Down arrows skip disabled days when moving by weeks.
Navigation respects minDate and maxDate boundaries.
Mouse selection and direct date input remain functional.
